Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. Puude raskusastme tuvastamine ja sotsiaaltoetuse maksmine: 3.2.1.2.1. Inimesel, kellel on terviseprobleemide tõttu raske igapäevaelus toime tulla ja ühiskonnas tegutseda või kes vajab igapäevaelus eakaaslastest rohkem juhendamist, järelevalvet või abi, on võimalus taotleda puude raskusastme määramist. Puude raskusastet tuvas tatakse nii lastel, tööealistel kui ka vanaduspensioniealistel. Selle tulemusel tekib inimesel õigus puuetega inimeste sotsiaaltoetusele. 3.2.1.3.
